title: Consecutive peak frequencies show no clear excess similarity in 46 selected CHIME sessions of FRB 20220912A
abstract: We test the order of first-component peak frequencies for FRB 20220912A in CHIME/FRB Catalog 2, release 20251231. In 46 sessions with at least three accepted events, the mean adjacent frequency gap is 82.94 MHz. Random order within each session gives 78.29 MHz. The gap reduction is -5.93%, with a nominal session-bootstrap 95% interval of -14.45% to +2.91%. Early and later sessions both show no clear excess similarity. Quality cuts and a fitted linear transit-time control retain this null result. A 60-second control has larger gaps and needs a separate test. Only four adjacent pairs have gaps below 0.3 seconds, so the test does not assess the known short-time drift result with useful power. The result is conditional on catalog fits, detection, and session selection. It gives no physical memory limit or independent telescope confirmation. Code, frozen source rows, hashes, all control results, ordering injections, a figure, and offline instructions are included.
